title: The Truth Hour
description: Ronnie and Barry host their call-in conspiracy show. Tonight's caller, Frank, has evidence. Real evidence. The kind that makes governments sweat.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're listening to The Truth Hour on Snazzie FM. I'm your host, Ronnie Delacroix, and tonight... ohhh, tonight, we go there.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: We always go there, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We go further there.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hmm. Further there. Sure.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Our first caller tonight says he has proof. Real proof. The kind of proof that makes governments... sweat. Frank, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Ronnie, Ronnie, listen to me, okay? I need you to listen real careful here, because what I'm about to tell you, it's gonna change your whole life.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I'm ready, Frank. I'm ready.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Pigeons... <p:0.7> they aren't real, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...I have seen many pigeons, Frank.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: You're seeing what they want you to see, Barry!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You know, Frank... I have always had a feeling about pigeons. Something off about the eyes.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Those eyes? They're cameras, Ronnie. High resolution, and all of it gets uploaded to a server farm out in Nebraska.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...Why Nebraska, specifically?

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Lowest land value in the country, Barry. <p:0.4> Minimal air traffic. You think that's a coincidence? They picked it on purpose. Nobody's looking.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Huh. He's... he's not wrong about the land values.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So what you are telling me, Frank... is that every pigeon I have ever fed a pretzel to... was watching me.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: They're reporting on you, Ronnie. <p:0.4> Every pretzel goes into a hidden compartment. They measure the sodium. That's how they keep a file on everything you eat.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Ohhh... <p:0.6> I'm not well, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You're fine, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Frank, how do they charge them? The pigeon drones. Where does the power come from?

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: The bread, Barry. <p:0.4> The bread is the battery. That's where they get the power. Why do you think they push it on you?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ...Of course it is.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That is... that is not how bread works.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: That is exactly how bread works, Barry. <p:0.4> Look it up. Go on. You can't, can you? They scrubbed it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Frank... I want to thank you. For your courage. And your service. You are a patriot.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Do not feed the pigeons. <p:0.4> You hear me? Tell everyone. Before it's too late.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll be right back after this. And please... do not, under any circumstances, feed the pigeons.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...I literally fed a pigeon this morning.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, I think I need to lie down.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We can't lie down, Barry. We're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Ronnie! It's Frank again. I forgot one thing.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Go ahead, Frank.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: The squirrels are in on it too now. <p:0.4> They've formed an alliance with the pigeons.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: An alliance. <p:0.3> You heard it here first, folks.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: And the squirrels report to the pigeons. <p:0.4> The pigeons report to Nebraska. It's a chain of command.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A chain of command. For rodents.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Bingo, Barry. <p:0.3> Now you're finally thinking.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm getting my coat.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry... <p:0.9> You're done, son.
